proposed.statement: The April 1 2026 capture says ChatGPT Plus users could send up to 160 messages with raw model label GPT-5.3 every three hours, then chats switched to a mini model until reset.

evidence.excerpt: Plus and ChatGPT Go users can send up to 160 messages with GPT-5.3 every 3 hours. After reaching this limit, chats will switch to the mini version.
